# BTicino C300X Integration v1.6.0

This release moves browser media to Home Assistant's WebRTC provider/go2rtc path
and removes the integration-local `aiortc` WebRTC runtime.

## Highlights

- On-demand video, Ring Call and Home Call browser streams now use Home
  Assistant's WebRTC provider/go2rtc path.
- The integration no longer installs or imports `aiortc` for browser media, so
  Home Assistant package resolution no longer has to satisfy an exact `aiortc`
  pin before video can start.
- Normal on-demand camera entity streams use the same audio+video RTSP source as
  the bundled card. Unanswered Ring Call previews remain video-only and
  multi-browser capable.

## Added

- Native-agent RTSP backchannel support forwards browser microphone audio
  through the existing local device talkback path.

## Fixed

- Home Assistant's go2rtc integration is loaded as the required WebRTC provider,
  and failed provider offers are cleaned up without leaving local media sessions
  active.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.6.0`; the
  go2rtc talkback path needs the matching native-agent RTSP backchannel support.
- Browser microphone/talkback still requires HTTPS or Home Assistant Cloud.
